operating_notes.text: Mutual fund QAAUM ₹12.6 trillion with 15.1% overall market share; active QAAUM ₹8.6 trillion (up 10% YoY, 21% three-year CAGR) and passive QAAUM ₹4 trillion (up 12% YoY).
Monthly SIP flows nearly ₹4,000 Cr, of which about ₹1,300 Cr comes from the SBI channel and ₹2,700 Cr from other channels and direct; 65% of SIP count originates in B30 locations.

Distribution runs through over 23,000 SBI branches, 124,000 independent financial advisors, nearly 10,000 national distributors and 90 banking partners, reaching 98% of pin codes; unique investors 1.82 crore, up 12%.
Q2FY27 equity yields averaged 62-63 bps, debt yields 34-35 bps, and liquid yields 11-12 bps.
SBI channel contributes approximately 20% of net inflows, in line with its share of overall AUM.
